executive_verdict.primary_failure_mode: Contradictory validation contracts and fragmented artifact/run-state ownership
executive_verdict.most_urgent_fix: Replace checker semantics and explicit test profiles using retained incident fixtures

scope.target_name: Yapi merchant generation and editor lifecycle
limitations: No live model calls or application edits during audit

findings.title: Equivalent CSS colors fail verification
findings.mechanism: Literal hex strings are compared to browser-computed RGB strings.
findings.root_cause: The check contract lacks semantic value normalization.
findings.recommended_fix: Normalize expected CSS in the browser and include observed values.

findings.title: Video acceptance contradicts reduced-motion testing
findings.mechanism: The sandbox forces reduced motion while the plan requires a visible video whose accessible fallback hides it.
findings.root_cause: The test profile is implicit rather than part of the requirement.
findings.recommended_fix: Define separate normal playback and reduced-motion fallback assertions.

findings.title: Model-authored checks become frozen blockers
findings.mechanism: Selectors and literal expectations are fixed after editing and retried as if every failure were an implementation defect.
findings.root_cause: Merchant intent and the checker implementation share one model-authored contract.
findings.recommended_fix: Use typed semantic requirements with separately validated checker bindings and independent coverage.

findings.title: Preview, verification and commit lack one artifact identity
findings.mechanism: The workspace, mutating candidate gate, preview preparation and save preparation can process different source representations.
findings.root_cause: Several layers own normalization, preparation and acceptance.
findings.recommended_fix: Prepare an immutable artifact once per digest; verify and commit that exact artifact.

findings.title: Run lifecycle and expiry policies disagree
findings.mechanism: Process-local jobs may run over 12 minutes, but cleanup expires RUNNING jobs after 10 minutes and recovery excludes INTERRUPTED.
findings.root_cause: No unified durable execution contract with heartbeat and lease.
findings.recommended_fix: Introduce durable idempotent jobs, fenced leases, heartbeat, resume and cancellation.

findings.title: Recovery banner displaces the preview
findings.mechanism: A fourth grid child is inserted into a three-row canvas layout; the banner occupies the flexible content row.
findings.root_cause: Run-state UI lacks stable layout slots and geometry assertions.
findings.recommended_fix: Replace independent editor flags with explicit state views and stable layout slots.

findings.title: Failures lose actionable diagnostic categories
findings.mechanism: The bridge collapses thrown exceptions into connection_unavailable; planning diagnostics are omitted.
findings.root_cause: Error taxonomy and stage provenance are not preserved across boundaries.
findings.recommended_fix: Preserve safe typed error categories, stage, status, retryability and request correlation.

findings.title: Evaluation does not cover the released user path
findings.mechanism: Development and production engine defaults differ; candidate evaluation bypasses chat and starts from an existing snapshot.
findings.root_cause: Component evidence is treated as whole-product readiness.
findings.recommended_fix: Pin the primary engine and gate releases on repeated full UI-to-save scenarios.

findings.title: Request intent passes through overlapping representations
findings.mechanism: Historical setup, summaries, prose markers, generic design recipes and generated assertions all influence execution.
findings.root_cause: Confirmed merchant facts and inferred implementation guidance lack a single typed boundary.
findings.recommended_fix: Normalize intent once and preserve explicit choice and asset provenance.

ordered_fix_plan.goal: Preserve failing fixtures and add safe stage traces
ordered_fix_plan.why_now: Establish a trustworthy baseline before replacing behavior
Proven false negatives currently cause pointless repairs
ordered_fix_plan.expected_effect: Correct checks for semantic values and motion profiles

ordered_fix_plan.why_now: Preview and save must refer to identical verified bytes

ordered_fix_plan.goal: Replace run orchestration with durable jobs
ordered_fix_plan.why_now: Reloads, retries and expiry need consistent ownership
Retained work must remain usable and visible

ordered_fix_plan.goal: Consolidate scratch, template and edit entry paths
Run the repeated end-to-end release gate
ordered_fix_plan.why_now: Unit counts and one success do not establish readiness
